template:
Apply only to heart_rate input. Treat metadata.value as the current BPM and evaluate configured Triggers only when it is a valid numeric BPM. Missing or invalid BPM does not establish a match. Do not invent thresholds or replace configured conditions with generic advice.

Configured Triggers:
__BEHAVIOR_RULES__

Choose the single strongest matching Trigger.

When a Trigger clearly matches the current BPM:
- Put tags first in the JSON object. Put its exact Rule tag in tags.
- Include "[supervisor_subject:<stable current situation>]". Keep supervisor_subject stable across insignificant BPM fluctuations and summary rewording.
- Set should_speak=true and proactive_candidate="".
- Keep summary short and state the current BPM evidence that matched.

When no Trigger clearly matches, set should_speak=false and omit Rule and supervisor_subject tags.

Set should_generate_image=false and visual_candidate="".
